C1333.title: Massive ClickFix Phishing Campaign Targets Hotel Systems to Spread PureRAT Remote Access Trojan
C1333.summary: In November 2025, Push Security disclosed a large-scale ClickFix phishing campaign targeting hotel systems. The operation embedded videos, countdown timers, and a counter showing 'users verified in the last hour' on fake verification pages to enhance deception.
